impact_summary: Change Healthcare claims clearinghouse halted nationally; $872M initial direct response costs; estimated total impact over $1.6B.
Russian state group accessed senior leadership emails and cybersecurity staff correspondence via legacy test tenant password spraying.
Threat actor exfiltrated data from HPE cloud email environment targeting cybersecurity, marketing, and legal executives.
Company shut down core transactional systems, delaying real estate closings nationwide and requiring manual escrow workflows.
Compromised administrative credentials; accessed internal company documents and employee records with no customer data breach reported.
Encrypted servers forced company to take loan servicing portals offline; personal data of 16.6 million individuals compromised; $27M charge.
Consumer fulfillment centers for The North Face and Vans severely disrupted during peak holiday season; 35.5 million consumer records exfiltrated.
109 million customer call and text records exfiltrated from third-party cloud database; DOJ granted two 30-day delay exemptions on national security grounds.
Automotive dealer management systems crippled across 15,000 dealerships for nearly two weeks; reported $25M cryptocurrency ransom payment.
Shut down internal enterprise resource planning and field operations networks; corporate campus staff instructed to work remotely.
Largest regulated water utility in the US disconnected online customer portal and billing; water and wastewater operations remained safe.
Disrupted semiconductor manufacturing facilities and delayed customer order fulfillment; exfiltrated employee and proprietary operational data.
